title: Square Numbers and Patterns
summary: Square numbers as square arrays, the odd-number pattern, last digits, and the locker puzzle.

ib.note: Investigating number patterns builds MYP Criterion B

cbse.chapter: Ganita Prakash Ch 1: A Square and A Cube
Earlier NCERT Ch 5: Squares and Square Roots

objectives: I can recognise and calculate square numbers.
I can describe and explain patterns in square numbers.
I can use last digits to rule out perfect squares.
misconceptions: If a number ends in 1, 4, 5, 6, 9 or 0, it must be a square.
Most numbers have an odd number of factors.
